trails.title: Trail ① A Rainy Day Friend
trails.description: Lift the lord's nose, pinch the lady's ear. "You can do away with the raincoat and boots!" A masked friend greets you warmly on the porch: "Come and enjoy this wonderful rain!"

content.text:
Venus, Venus, when your golden blood cascades upon us,
Passing through the shimmering azure, over ankles and veins, and supple thighs so pure,
A hammer falls at the temple's core,
You forget.
Touching night with your foot's tip once more.

Oh, Venus, have you already left me?
Oh, Venus, could you be no more?
Applaud, applaud, applaud, and cheer! Fulfill that raucous roar!
Dances not unpaced in the coffin's stiff embrace, for you, majestic and sublime, do offer meager praise.
I follow you, Venus, follow your fingertips in a haze,
Stepping onto the path back to better-sweet days.

items.text: Only Applause

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: gundongzimu_1#0.1#52

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: ... It is going smoothly.

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: Looks like Isolde is going to finish the show.

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: But how did she get on stage? No one saw her backstage!

items.speaker: Hofmann
items.text: A secret passage, like at the exhibition.

items.speaker: Hofmann
items.text: Marcus, keep an eye on Isolde. I'll go find Heinrich. The branch staff will take action as soon as she comes off the stage.

items.speaker: Hofmann
items.text: I'll talk to you on the intercom.
Hofmann rises from her seat.
The surrounding audience look at her disapprovingly.
Marcus stares intently at the stage.
The spotlight shines, casting its beam on the stage's sole protagonist.
Vienna's unparalleled nightingale.
But Marcus has no interest in her beautiful songs—she is only calculating the progress of the unseen drama.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: gundongzimu_2#0.1#49

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: This is the second act. Scarpia, the chief of police, will propose a bargain.

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: Tosca will pretend to submit, and request safe-conduct for her and Cavaradossi.

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: When Scarpia signs the paper ...
Her focused state narrows her vision. Marcus can even feel the slight tremble of the star's hair as she sings.

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: *deep breath*
Tosca bows before the statue, brewing her revenge.

items.speaker: Scarpia
items.text: And which road do you choose?

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: "The shortest one! Civitavecchia."
A small piece of paper is retracted from Tosca's fingertips.

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: ... Almost there, almost there.
Tosca lifts the red silk from the table.
She picks up the dagger, plunging it into the heart of the police chief.
Facing the man lying in a pool of blood, she laughs aloud and maniacally.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: This is Tosca's kiss!

items.speaker: “Scarpia”
items.text: Ah!

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: Wait. Something's wrong.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: Are you choking on your blood?

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: The man lying on the ground ...

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: That's Mr. Karl, from the branch?!

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: Is he really ... bleeding?!
Marcus shoots up from the gallery.
The information her "reading" reveals causes the telescope to slip from her hands.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: What? Are you sure?!

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: Definitely, Ms. Kakania! He's not acting. That's real blood! Coming out of Mr. Karl's body!

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: The assassination in the story has become reality! Why is the show still on?!

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: Why ... Why isn't the audience reacting?! What about the branch staff?

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: Madam Hofmann! Can you hear me?!
Her cries go unheard. The audience remains attentive and silent.
There is no sound from the communicator.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: D**n it. What is going on?!
Kakania rushes down from her seat.
She runs through the audience, whose expressions remain unchanged, with heads locked straight to the front of the stage.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: It really is ... Mr. Karl ...
The pool of blood beneath Karl slowly spreads, steaming in the cool air.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Why? Why is no one ...

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Are you all mad?! A man has been killed, don't you see?! Stop the show!!
The audience sits calmly and unfazed.
The music continues.
On the stage, Isolde, playing Tosca, turns around, revealing a pleased expression.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: Cavaradossi, have you escaped from jail?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: W-What?

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: My poor lover, you were put into jail only because you were too kindhearted. I've been trying to clear your name.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: Scarpia proposed an unfair deal. He wanted me as his mistress.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: But now he is dead, at last! The whole of Rome was overshadowed by his power.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: W-What are you talking about, Isolde? That's not what the story is like ...

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: Run away with me, Cavaradossi! I have the safe conduct.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: We will go to the sacred kingdom of happiness and freedom ... where no one knows us!

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: What, what are these ...

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: "Ausker Botiorak poisoned to death." ... "Frasnik shot dead." ... And ... "Hötzenhof assassinated."... "King of Greece assassinated." ... "Archduke Franz assassinated."

items.speaker: Marcus
items.text: All these assassinations ... at the same time?
Applause comes from the main hall, from the balconies, from beneath the dome, from beyond the unreachable sky, all converging into an unstoppable frenzy of sound.
It rings through the hall like a torrential downpour.

items.speaker: Hofmann
items.text: Marcus, change of plan.

items.speaker: Hofmann
items.text: We have a code red. Evacuate immediately.
TO BE CONTINUED…
